name: GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets)
description: The GAN V100 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets) is a superlight 55 mm speed cube built for fast, accurate turning with simple, repeatable tuning. Piece magnets give precise layer “clicks,” MagLev replaces springs with repelling magnets for a low-friction feel, and core magnets (corner-to-core) add stability so layers realign quickly during high-TPS solves—all at just ~ 64 g.
features: Fast, low-friction feel: MagLev elasticity removes spring noise and wear for smoother, quicker turns.
Stable alignment: Core magnets pull layers into place for cleaner execution and fewer lockups.
Light and agile: ~64 g superlight build reduces hand fatigue during long practice sessions.
Confident control: 76 total magnets provide consistent, accurate feedback on every move.
Easy, repeatable setup: 72 tension/compression combinations let you dial in from soft and fast to firm and controlled—no guesswork.
Everyday durable: Frosted exterior resists smudges and keeps grip consistent over time.
